items.title: Is DoorDash (DASH) Undervalued Following Its New Lyft Partnership?
items.summary: DoorDash (DASH) is back in focus after Lyft announced Lyft Go, a new membership that links directly with DashPass and lets riders earn credits redeemable for both rides and DoorDash orders. items.title: DoorDash Rose 13% in a Week. Is the $17 Billion Instacart Deal Really That Good?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash (DASH) stock gained 13% from October 26 to November 2, outperforming the Nasdaq 100 ETF’s roughly 4% decline after record quarterly earnings and a major acquisition announcement. Instacart (CART) agreed to be acquired for approximately $17 billion, bringing DoorDash grocery delivery capabilities and a valuable advertising business.

items.title: Amazon Gives Prime Members Uber Eats, Opening a New Front Against DoorDash
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAmazon and Uber now give US Prime members $0 delivery fees on Uber Eats restaurant orders of $25 or more placed through Amazon. The perk puts DoorDash’s main rival in front of Prime households at no extra cost, straight at the DashPass subscriptions DoorDash relies on.
